_about: Fleetio (Secure Fleet) API: read-only tools (GET only). Claude Messages API format: pass data['tools'] as the tools parameter. Each tool maps to an HTTP route in data['routes']. Generated from the official OpenAPI spec; contains no real account data.

api.how_to_execute: tools[i].name -> routes[name]. Substitute path_params into path; send query_params as query string. Params listed in deep_object_query_params are objects serialized as filter[field][op]=value / sort[field]=asc|desc. Write tools: remaining inputs go to the JSON body. Keys are read from environment variables, never hard-coded.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List Accounts (GET /accounts). Allows you to see information about the corresponding account(s) related to a given API key or Organization, such as the company name and address. This endpoint does not require you to pass in the Account-Token header. When not using an Organization Token, the API key must be passed in via the Authorization header as this API key is what is used… Use when the user asks which Fleetio account(s) this API key belongs to or about company-level account info. Response contains account tokens and addresses; never repeat tokens to the user. Paginated: request a small per_page (5-20); only pass next_cursor as start_cursor if the user needs more.
